text: Evening. My daughter's 14 months and she's got a temp of 38.5 tonight. Pretty sure it's teeth, she's dribbling heaps, chewing on everything she can get her hands on and one cheek's gone bright red. She's feeding fine though, had her usual bottle and a decent drink of water, so no dramas there. Just thought I'd check in whether the temp sounds about right for teething or if it's probably something else. No rush
